records.title: Implementation of Four Labour Code
details: Part(a) to (d): As a step towards implementation of the four Labour Codes, the Central Government has pre-published the draft Rules, inviting comments of all stakeholders. The Government has undertaken three tripartite consultations on the draft Central Rules under all the four Codes on 24.12.2020, 12.01.2021 and 20.01.2021. As per available information, 32, 30, 31 and 31 States/Union Territories have pre-published the draft Rules under the Code on Wages, 2019, the Industrial Relations Code, 2020, the Code on Social Security, 2020 and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020, respectively.
